softwareInnerHero.title: Design Efficient Drainage Systems with Confidence
paragraphs: Autodesk InfoDrainage is the comprehensive software solution for designing, analyzing, and managing stormwater and wastewater networks. Built on the powerful ArcGIS platform, it combines advanced hydraulic modeling with geospatial intelligence to deliver accurate and efficient drainage system designs.

With InfoDrainage, you can design everything from simple residential drainage systems to complex municipal stormwater networks. The software helps you comply with regulatory requirements, optimize system performance, and reduce construction costs through intelligent design and analysis.

From rainfall analysis and system design to flood risk assessment and sustainable drainage solutions (SuDS), InfoDrainage provides all the tools you need to create resilient and effective drainage infrastructure.

cardSections.subheading: Discover how InfoDrainage transforms drainage system design

items.title: Rainfall Analysis
items.body: Analyze rainfall data using multiple methods including IDF curves, historical data, and climate change projections to design for current and future conditions.

items.title: Hydraulic Modeling
items.body: Perform advanced hydraulic analysis of drainage networks including steady-state, dynamic, and flood modeling to understand system behavior under various conditions.

items.title: GIS Integration
items.body: Leverage the full power of ArcGIS for spatial analysis, terrain modeling, and visualization of drainage networks in a geospatial context.

items.title: SuDS Design
items.body: Design sustainable drainage systems including green roofs, permeable pavements, and rain gardens to manage stormwater runoff and improve water quality.

items.title: Flood Risk Assessment
items.body: Evaluate flood risks, model flood extents, and develop mitigation strategies to protect properties and infrastructure from flooding.

items.title: Comprehensive Reporting
items.body: Generate detailed reports, plans, and calculations to support regulatory compliance and communicate design decisions to stakeholders.

cardSections.subheading: Why civil engineers and water professionals choose InfoDrainage

items.body: Accelerate drainage system design with intuitive tools, automated calculations, and integrated workflows that reduce design time by up to 50%.

items.title: Regulatory Compliance
